inflight_experience_food_beverage: Anything about food or drinks during the flight (quality, taste, temperature, freshness, quantity, variety, special meals, drink service). PRIORITY: HIGH only for serious safety/health risk explicitly described (e.g., food poisoning, severe allergy negligence, foreign object like glass/metal in food). MEDIUM if pre-ordered/paid meal is missing, food is inedible, or a dietary requirement was not met but without serious harm. LOW for taste preference, temperature, limited options, or minor service complaints.
inflight_experience_seats_comfort: Seat comfort on board (legroom, recline, seat width, cushioning, ability to sleep/rest, personal space, seat layout). PRIORITY: HIGH only for clear safety hazard or injury explicitly described (e.g., broken seat causing injury, sharp metal edge, seatbelt failure). MEDIUM for major functional failures that materially impact the flight (e.g., recline/power broken on long-haul). LOW for general comfort complaints, tight legroom, noise, or cosmetic wear and tear.
inflight_experience_entertainment: In-flight entertainment and connectivity (screens, movies/TV/music, games, Wi-Fi/internet, system usability, system not working). PRIORITY: HIGH is rarely used unless exposed wiring/safety issue. MEDIUM if Wi-Fi/screens not working on long-haul flights (paid service failure). LOW for poor movie selection, slow interface, or issues on short flights.
inflight_experience_cabin_service: Cabin crew and service during the flight (friendliness, politeness, professionalism, responsiveness, language skills, service speed/attentiveness). PRIORITY: HIGH only for explicit severe misconduct/safety impact (harassment, discrimination, threats/physical aggression, refusal to assist in a medical emergency). MEDIUM for clearly rude/unprofessional behavior or repeated refusal to assist. LOW for minor slowness, lack of warmth, or language barriers.
inflight_experience_cleanliness: Cleanliness inside the aircraft (seats, tray tables, toilets, floors, smell, general hygiene, trash not collected, dirty cabin). PRIORITY: HIGH only for explicit biohazard/safety risk (blood, vomit, feces exposure), insect/rodent infestation, or conditions that pose health risk. MEDIUM for very dirty cabin/toilets or persistent bad odor impacting the flight. LOW for general wear, water spots, light mess, or untidiness.
checkin_process: Check-in experience at the airport or online (desks, kiosks, queues, waiting time, staff at check-in, technical issues with check-in). PRIORITY: HIGH only if check-in failure or staff action clearly causes missed flight/stranding and is explicitly stated (e.g., system prevented check-in entirely and passenger missed the flight). MEDIUM for very long queues, repeated system failures, or staff refusal to help that causes major stress/disruption. LOW for minor waits, kiosk UI confusion, or aesthetic complaints.
boarding_process: Boarding at the gate (announcements, boarding order, priority boarding, crowd management, waiting at the gate, confusion during boarding). PRIORITY: HIGH only for explicit denied boarding/serious safety risk (e.g., dangerous overcrowding, physical confrontation) clearly described. MEDIUM for chaotic boarding, severe confusion, or poor handling that causes missed boarding. LOW for minor delays or unclear announcements.
flight_delay_cancellation: Flight delays/cancellations and disruption handling (late departure/arrival, missed connections due to delay, cancellations, rebooking, lack of updates). PRIORITY: HIGH only for extreme disruption explicitly described (e.g., stranded overnight/multi-day with no assistance, vulnerable/medical situation worsened by lack of care, or abandonment without basic necessities). MEDIUM for major delays/cancellations, missed connections, or serious rebooking/communication failures. LOW for short delays, minor schedule changes, or general mentions without significant impact.
baggage_lost: Lost or missing baggage (bags not arriving, bags delayed to another flight, bags sent to the wrong airport or never found). PRIORITY: HIGH only if the bag contains essential medical items/assistive devices or other critical necessities explicitly stated and the bag is still missing. MEDIUM for currently missing baggage without critical contents, or delayed baggage that required significant effort to resolve. LOW if feedback is retrospective (already resolved) or minor inconvenience.
baggage_damaged: Damaged baggage (broken wheels, torn bags, damaged contents, visible damage after arrival). PRIORITY: HIGH only for critical damage explicitly described (e.g., destroyed medical device/wheelchair, bag ripped open with major loss, essential contents destroyed). MEDIUM for clearly broken wheels/handles or damage requiring compensation/replacement. LOW for scratches, minor dents, or normal wear and tear.
booking_and_ticketing: Booking and ticket management (website/app issues, payment problems, ticket changes, rebooking, schedule changes, errors during purchase, confirmation issues). PRIORITY: HIGH only for explicit severe financial/critical travel impact (e.g., payment taken but no ticket issued, repeated/large incorrect charges, confirmed booking cancelled by system with immediate travel impact). MEDIUM for major booking/change failures, repeated crashes, or errors that block changes. LOW for confusing UI, minor app glitches, or simple typo corrections.
customer_support: Any interaction with customer support (call center, email, chat, social media), including response time, politeness, clarity, helpfulness, and resolution quality. PRIORITY: HIGH only for explicit severe cases (e.g., threats/harassment/discrimination, fraud/unauthorized actions, or critical misinformation that causes major harm like deportation/large financial loss). MEDIUM for repeated failure to resolve an important issue, very long delays in resolution, or clearly unhelpful handling that materially prolongs the problem. LOW for long hold times, generic replies, minor rudeness, or general process feedback.
pricing_and_loyalty: Ticket prices, extra fees, value for money, and loyalty/miles (fare levels, hidden charges, surcharges, fairness of price, miles/points, status, benefits). PRIORITY: HIGH only for explicit unauthorized/incorrect high-impact charges or points loss (e.g., double-charged large amounts, unauthorized mileage deduction, denial of critical paid benefit with major disruption). MEDIUM for missing miles, incorrect fees, or significant benefit issues without severe consequences. LOW for general complaints about high prices or program rules.
